sources: crates/kestrike/src/failover/records.rs, the prefix layout, which places the checkpoint slots from unit 1 of the metadata prefix, in 4096-byte units

crates/kestrike/src/storage/recovery/mod.rs, module documentation, invariant ONE-QUALIFIED-WRITE-PER-BLOCK: the prefix splits into blocks of the persistence profile's unit, "block 0 root slot A and block 1 root slot B"
disagrees: With a persistence unit above 4096 bytes, root block 1 covers bytes that source 1 gives to checkpoint units, so a checkpoint-unit write overwrites a root slot.
